conclusion.measured_bottleneck: Cold first bridge evaluation is dominated by native target construction. Warm reused processes reduce it while rebuilding targets; model metrics remain small. Dispatch saves less than individual optimizer time because verified sparse replay, startup/source guards and coordinator completion are included.
conclusion.recommendation: Keep process reuse opt-in until repeated full-route measurements demonstrate net benefit. Profile completion replays, source guard calls and resource wrapper inventories separately before optimizing those boundaries; preserve their checks.
conclusion.unmeasured_cause_note: The extra residual seconds cannot be assigned to a specific function from current receipts. Source inspection identifies repeated owner completion replay and package manifest scans as candidates for finer profiling, not proven causes.

pipeline_breakdown.pool_pre_job_guard_timing_scope: Nested inside dispatch; not additional wall time. No comparable explicit guard field for fresh workers.
pipeline_breakdown.replay_timing_scope: Owner acceptance replay is already inside dispatch; subsequent completion replay and candidate qualification loading are separate and not separately timed.
pipeline_breakdown.unallocated_scope: Residual, not directly measured attribution: CLI/resource wrapper and storage inventories, source guards, repeated completion verification/replay, registry/progress work and teardown outside the dispatch and qualification timers.

resources.memory_note: Sampled group RSS is a lower bound on the true peak and double-counts shared pages; worker max_rss is cumulative process lifetime, not per-job peak. Reused workers retain imported runtime/allocator state, not a trusted model state.
